column3: Pizza. Wings. All the things! Pizza Hut—for the love of pizza since 1958. No one loves pizza more than Pizza Hut. Located on the second floor of the Business Building, inside the RowdyMart.
Located on the first floor of the John Peace Library, Sushic is your go-to spot for fresh sushi rolls, made-to-order poke bowls, potstickers, ramen and more!

It starts with bagels, fresh-from-the-oven and ends with total, delicious satisfaction. Discover your next favorite bagels and shmear at Einstein Bros. Bagels located on the first floor of the BSE (Business, Science and Engineering Building).

Located on the first floor of the John Peace Library, our full-service Starbucks offers high-quality coffees, hand-crafted espresso drinks, teas, smoothies, and a variety of pastries, pre-packaged snacks, and breakfast sandwiches. With every cup, with every conversation, with every community—Starbucks nurtures the limitless possibilities of human connection. Order ahead on the Grubhub Mobile App or the Starbucks Mobile App.
